methods.label: Subtract tens using place value
methods.explanation: \(31\) is 3 tens and 1 one. Subtracting \(30\) removes the 3 tens, leaving \(1\), so \(31-30=1\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 1 mental subtraction of a multiple of ten and tens-and-ones place value.
